categories.objective: A clean user can register, complete dietary onboarding, and receive a first streamed answer
A returning user reaches the TUI without repeating registration and conversation remains usable
Household targeting and Grocery review, edit, cancel, accept, and stale-authority handling are understandable and correct
Cancellation, uncertain outcomes, typed failures, and process exits leave the user informed and the terminal usable
The installed artifact remains legible and semantically complete across supported widths and color modes

roadmap_observations.note: Bare launch begins create-account authorization without exposing the existing-account login path; promote the corrected copy into the clean-user installed-artifact assertion.
Track as product coverage debt, not a v0.5.0 regression.
Requires provider configuration and a separately authorized privacy-safe canary.
Requires opt-in artifacts and real-hardware qualification.
Ordinary Windows source qualification remains active; public distribution is separate.

limitations: The automated score covers the supported installed-artifact contract, not aesthetic taste or long-session comfort.
The deterministic backend proves client behavior without mutating a production household.
Production availability and latency require a dedicated least-privilege canary account before they can run unattended.
Deferred roadmap capabilities are visible as coverage debt and do not masquerade as v0.5.0 regressions.
